    """
    A cartographic projection in the Oblique Mercator projection.

    The Mercator cylinder of projection is rotated so that its line of
    tangency - the central line - runs at an arbitrary azimuth, instead of
    following the equator (:class:`Mercator`) or a meridian

    """Build an independent Cartopy projection from CF grid-mapping attrs."""
    if "semi_major_axis" in attributes:

            semimajor_axis=attributes["semi_major_axis"],
            semiminor_axis=attributes["semi_minor_axis"],

        central_latitude=attributes["latitude_of_projection_origin"],
        false_easting=attributes.get("false_easting", 0.0),

def _grid_locations(cube):
    """Transform the cube's projected coordinates to true lat/lon."""
    x_coord = cube.coord(axis="x", dim_coords=True)
    y_coord = cube.coord(axis="y", dim_coords=True)
    projection = x_coord.coord_system.as_cartopy_projection()
    x_grid, y_grid = np.meshgrid(x_coord.points, y_coord.points)
    locations = ccrs.PlateCarree().transform_points(
        projection, x_grid, y_grid
    )
    return locations[..., 0], locations[..., 1]

def _coord_metadata(grid_mapping_name):
    if grid_mapping_name == hh.CF_GRID_MAPPING_LAT_LON:
        return ("latitude", "degrees_north", "longitude", "degrees_east")
    elif grid_mapping_name == hh.CF_GRID_MAPPING_ROTATED_LAT_LON:
        return ("grid_latitude", "degrees", "grid_longitude", "degrees")
    else:
        return (
            "projection_y_coordinate",
            "m",
            "projection_x_coordinate",
            "m",
        )


def _make_netcdf(path, grid_mapping_name, attributes):
    y_name, y_units, x_name, x_units = _coord_metadata(grid_mapping_name)
    if grid_mapping_name in LATLON_MAPPINGS:
        y_points = np.linspace(-10.0, 10.0, 4)
        x_points = np.linspace(-5.0, 5.0, 5)
    else:
        y_points = np.linspace(-4.0e5, 4.0e5, 4)
        x_points = np.linspace(-5.0e5, 5.0e5, 5)

    dataset = nc.Dataset(path, "w", format="NETCDF4_CLASSIC")
    try:
        dataset.Conventions = "CF-1.10"
        dataset.createDimension("y", y_points.size)
        dataset.createDimension("x", x_points.size)

        y_var = dataset.createVariable("y", "f8", ("y",))
        y_var.standard_name = y_name
        y_var.units = y_units
        y_var.axis = "Y"
        y_var[:] = y_points

        x_var = dataset.createVariable("x", "f8", ("x",))
        x_var.standard_name = x_name
        x_var.units = x_units
        x_var.axis = "X"
        x_var[:] = x_points

        grid_var = dataset.createVariable("crs", "i4")
        grid_var.grid_mapping_name = grid_mapping_name
        for name, value in attributes.items():
            setattr(grid_var, name, value)

        data_var = dataset.createVariable("pr", "f4", ("y", "x"))
        data_var.standard_name = "precipitation_flux"
        data_var.units = "kg m-2 s-1"
        data_var.grid_mapping = "crs"
        data_var[:] = np.zeros((y_points.size, x_points.size), dtype="f4")
    finally:
        dataset.close()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("grid_mapping_name", sorted(GRID_MAPPINGS))
class TestGridMappingRoundTrip:
    @staticmethod
    def _load_and_reload(tmp_path, grid_mapping_name):
        source_path = tmp_path / "source.nc"
        _make_netcdf(
            source_path, grid_mapping_name, GRID_MAPPINGS[grid_mapping_name]
        )
        cube = iris.load_cube(str(source_path))
        checkpoint_path = tmp_path / "checkpoint.nc"
        iris.save(cube, str(checkpoint_path))
        return cube, iris.load_cube(str(checkpoint_path))

    def test_coord_system_loaded(self, tmp_path, grid_mapping_name):
        cube, _ = self._load_and_reload(tmp_path, grid_mapping_name)
        coord_system = cube.coord(axis="x", dim_coords=True).coord_system
        assert coord_system is not None
        assert coord_system.grid_mapping_name == grid_mapping_name

    def test_coord_system_preserved(self, tmp_path, grid_mapping_name):
        cube, reloaded = self._load_and_reload(tmp_path, grid_mapping_name)
        original = cube.coord(axis="x", dim_coords=True).coord_system
        assert reloaded.coord(axis="x", dim_coords=True).coord_system == (
            original
        )
        assert reloaded.coord(axis="y", dim_coords=True).coord_system == (
            original
        )

    def test_grid_locations_preserved(self, tmp_path, grid_mapping_name):
        # The geographic locations described by the grid must be unchanged.
        cube, reloaded = self._load_and_reload(tmp_path, grid_mapping_name)
        geographic = ccrs.PlateCarree()
        locations = []
        for check_cube in (cube, reloaded):
            x_coord = check_cube.coord(axis="x", dim_coords=True)
            y_coord = check_cube.coord(axis="y", dim_coords=True)
            projection = x_coord.coord_system.as_cartopy_projection()
            x_grid, y_grid = np.meshgrid(x_coord.points, y_coord.points)
            locations.append(
                geographic.transform_points(projection, x_grid, y_grid)
            )
        assert np.all(np.isfinite(locations[0][..., :2]))
        np.testing.assert_allclose(
            locations[1][..., :2], locations[0][..., :2], atol=1.0e-10
        )

    def test_saved_attributes_are_cf(self, tmp_path, grid_mapping_name):
        # Saved grid-mapping attributes must be CF attribute names, i.e. the
        # names the loader reads.
        cube, _ = self._load_and_reload(tmp_path, grid_mapping_name)
        checkpoint_path = tmp_path / "checkpoint.nc"
        known_cf_attributes = {
            value
            for name, value in vars(hh).items()
            if name.startswith("CF_ATTR_GRID") and isinstance(value, str)
        }
        known_cf_attributes.update(
            {"longitude_of_prime_meridian", "earth_radius"}
        )
        with nc.Dataset(checkpoint_path) as dataset:
            grid_vars = [
                variable
                for variable in dataset.variables.values()
                if hasattr(variable, "grid_mapping_name")
            ]
            assert grid_vars
            for grid_var in grid_vars:
                unknown = set(grid_var.ncattrs()) - known_cf_attributes
                assert not unknown, f"non-CF attributes saved: {unknown}"
